name: Craftsman's Writ: Explosive Sheep
objectiveText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction. Craftsman's Writ: Explosive Sheep  ( 1 ) Explosive Sheep  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Dropped for me in Darkshore.

Once you have the Explosive Sheep in your bag, the location becomes visible on the map. 

Location of the NPC: around 35.5, 26.7 - Arathi Highland, behind Northfold Manor 

The bag of coins as a reward contained around 44 silver. I was level 20 when handing it in during the beta.

got it in hillsbrad as a horde player, location for turn in is correct
i got 46s98c
